name: mcpNotify
description: Pushes an MCP notification to connected clients from anywhere: an ordinary page, a cfthread, or a scheduled job. This is the emit-from-anywhere ergonomic that wsPublish provides for WebSockets. The server argument is optional inside a handler (it defaults to the server the call is running on). When to is given, the notification is delivered only to that session; otherwise it is delivered to every session of the server that has a stream open. Returns the number of sessions reached. Always recorded into the mcp test log so the CFML test suite can assert on it with no client attached.

params.name: server
params.description: The MCP server to notify, e.g. "/mcp/docs". Inside a handler this defaults to the server of the current call.

params.name: method
params.description: The notification method name, e.g. "notifications/resources/updated". Required.

params.name: params
params.description: A struct of parameters to attach to the notification, converted to JSON for the wire.

params.name: to
params.description: An optional session id. When set, the notification is delivered only to that session instead of every open session of the server.

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Full documentation of the RustCFML Model Context Protocol support, including notifications from anywhere.

examples.title: Broadcast a resource update to every session
examples.description: From any page or background job, publish a resource-changed notification to all open sessions of a server.
examples.result: Returns the number of sessions the notification reached.

examples.title: Notify a single session
examples.description: Use mcpSessions() to get live ids, then target one of them with the to argument.
examples.result: Returns 1 when the target session had a stream open.
